objective: Characterize provider variation on byte-identical falsification inputs without conflating it with retrieval-resolution changes.

subjects.selection: Before any repeat call, freeze finding id, human disposition, repository id, snapshot commit, finding-row digest, architecture-artifact digest, and retrieval-index digest in an execution receipt.
exclusions: findings used to develop the repeatability implementation

held_constant: temperature, thresholds, retries, timeouts, and all context caps
reported_variation: verdict agreement and full disposition sequence
dated calculated dollar cost per observation
blockers: any subject or held-constant digest changes
any observation is missing authoritative provider usage
prompt, instrument, retry, timeout, or context configuration differs
any repetition is omitted, merged across stores, or reconstructed from historical output

approval_must_state: selected subject ids and immutable digests

interpretation.production_change: None. Stable or unstable results characterize the measurement system and do not automatically change prompts, thresholds, findings, or verdicts.
interpretation.closure: OPT-004 closes after all six bounded observations and the complete machine-readable characterization receipt are retained, regardless of whether variation is low or high.
